complete6_question_objects.question: A Spirit with no Energy remaining receives Gift of Strength and has already used an eligible cost-1 Power Card. May it use that card's Repeat without paying its cost again, or does Gift require the same repayment as Powerstorm?

When Green adds Presence via Growth, may it use destroyed disks while tracks still contain Presence? What is the price while Healthy versus Blighted? Does this special rule also let an ordinary Power Add Presence use destroyed disks?

Ocean has previously Drowned Invaders stored on its panel. Between actions in a later Spirit Phase, may it exchange them for Energy to help pay for cards that turn, or must it wait for another Drowning or the Gain Energy step?

Ocean chooses its Growth option with two “Add a Presence in any Ocean” instructions. May one disk be placed in the Ocean of a different island board where Ocean currently has no Presence, without measuring a numeric Range from its existing Presence?
When Spirits May Yet Dream grants its target an Element, may that Spirit choose an Element it currently has none of, or must the chosen Element already be present?
Green chooses its Reclaim-and-gain-Power Growth group. Does it also perform the separate ALWAYS Add Presence to Jungle/Wetland, or must it choose between that addition and Reclaim?

complete6_key_objects.answer: Yes. The eligible Gift of Strength Repeat can be used with no Energy remaining. Its printed cost limit is an eligibility limit, not a payment instruction. Powerstorm’s separate explicit repayment condition does not apply to Gift.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Ocean may exchange stored Drowned Invaders at the stated between-actions time in the later Spirit Phase; it need not wait for another Drowning or the normal Gain Energy step.
required_facts: Ocean may exchange stored Drowned Invaders at the stated between-actions time in the later Spirit Phase; it need not wait for another Drowning or the normal Gain Energy step.

old_question.question: Thunderspeaker has met both a threshold making one of its Innates Fast and a threshold that can affect game state. Is the Speed-changing threshold applied only at its printed position after the lower effects, or before checking the phase in which that Innate can be used?

new_question.question: Thunderspeaker has met both a threshold making one of its Innates Fast and a threshold that can affect game state. Is the Speed-changing threshold handled only as an ordinary effect when resolving that Innate, or applied before checking the phase in which the Innate can be used?

old_key.answer: Check and apply the Speed-changing threshold when checking the Power's Speed, before its ordinary effects. With those thresholds met, the Innate may be used Fast. The printed lower-effect order does not postpone its Speed change until after using a Slow Power.
